name: Bendamustine + Rituximab (BR) for mantle cell lymphoma
histology: mantle cell lymphoma (cyclin D1 positive / t(11;14))

biomarkers.CyclinD1_t(11;14): diagnostic hallmark of mantle cell lymphoma (diagnostic, not a dosing gate)
biomarkers.note: Rituximab requires CD20 positivity (Standard Guidelines (NCCN), B-cell Lymphomas v4.2026, lines 253 to 254, 566). Cyclin D1 / t(11;14) is the diagnostic hallmark of mantle cell lymphoma, not a dosing gate. BR is used for patients not planned for intensive/transplant-based induction.

treatmentSetting: primary therapy for mantle cell lymphoma in patients not selected for intensive (transplant-based) induction
lineOfTherapy: first-line (primary) induction therapy for less-intensive candidates

eligibilityCriteria.locator: v4.2026, Mantle Cell Lymphoma MANT-1 (line 94); Bendamustine + Rituximab followed by Rituximab maintenance (line 372)

drugs.name: Rituximab

provenance.locator: Harrison line 385777 (rituximab 375 mg/m2 once a week for 4 weeks) and line 120283 (usual dose 375 mg/m2 on day -1 before chemotherapy); DeVita line 323457.

drugs.notes: Source: Harrison lines 385777 and 120283; DeVita line 323457. Rituximab 375 mg/m2 IV on day 1 of each cycle. Requires CD20 positivity; infusion-reaction premedication and HBV screening before anti-CD20 therapy.

supportiveCare: Rituximab maintenance follows BR induction in mantle cell lymphoma (Standard Guidelines (NCCN), B-cell Lymphomas v4.2026, line 372: Bendamustine + Rituximab followed by Rituximab maintenance, 2 years).
HBV screening and reactivation prophylaxis before anti-CD20 (rituximab).
PJP and antiviral (VZV) prophylaxis consideration (bendamustine causes prolonged lymphopenia).
Antiemetics: bendamustine moderate emetic risk; prophylaxis per emetogenicity tier.
Tumor lysis syndrome prophylaxis for high tumor burden.

monitoring: CBC with differential before each cycle
lymphocyte count / infection surveillance (prolonged lymphopenia with bendamustine)
renal and hepatic function before each cycle

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for bendamustine + rituximab (BR) in mantle cell lymphoma (#77). Rituximab 375 mg/m2 (day 1) is dose-grounded (Harrison lines 385777 and 120283; DeVita line 323457). Bendamustine dose is set to VERIFY: the BR bendamustine dose (conventionally 90 mg/m2 IV on days 1 and 2, 28-day cycle) is not printed in the provided extracts. Regimen role, the follow-on rituximab maintenance (2 years) and the CD20 requirement are grounded to Standard Guidelines (NCCN), B-cell Lymphomas v4.2026 (MANT-1 line 94; line 372; CD20 lines 253 to 254, 566). Cyclin D1 / t(11;14) is the diagnostic hallmark of mantle cell lymphoma, not a dosing gate. Rituximab requires CD20 positivity, infusion premedication and HBV screening; bendamustine causes prolonged lymphopenia (consider PJP/VZV prophylaxis). Mantle cell lymphoma is generally not curable with this regimen, so intent is palliative (disease control). This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
